title: Anansi and the Cook Pots
mainIdea: Greed can cause problems and lead to unpleasant consequences.

pages.text: Anansi loved food but was too lazy to cook for himself.

question.text: Who is the main character in the story?

pages.text: Anansi wanted to eat meals from all of his friends' cook pots.

options: To eat food from all his friends

pages.text: Anansi tied webs from eight cook pots to his eight legs, but all the food became ready at the same time.

options: He forgot where the food was
All the cook pots were ready at once

pages.text: When his friends pulled the webs, Anansi's legs were stretched in eight different directions.

question.text: What happened when the friends pulled the webs?
options: His legs were pulled in different directions

pages.text: Anansi climbed out of the river with long, skinny legs and realized his greed had caused the trouble.

options: Anansi learned a lesson about greed

elements.correct: To eat food from all of his friends without cooking
distractors: To cook a big feast for everyone in the village
To learn how to make eight pots of soup at once

elements.correct: All of the cook pots became ready at the same time
distractors: All of his friends forgot to cook that morning
All of the pots were carried away by the river

elements.correct: Every web attached to his legs was pulled at once
distractors: Every web slipped off his legs before the meal
Every friend carried a full pot to his house

elements.correct: His legs stretched out, and he learned about greed
distractors: His legs stayed short, and he cooked his own meal
His webs disappeared, and he ate alone that night
